Context: 2. Earned Leave

He proceeds alone to the new place and joins the .pest without availing full joining time and takes his family later within the permissible time for claiming travelling allowance for the family. - Rule 26.  
- (b) The credit of earned leave plus the unavailed joining time credited should not exceed 300 days (in addition to the number of days for which encashment has been allowed along with LTC).  
- Rule 26 (1) (a) (ii) and proviso thereunder.
